name: Berkeley Public Library Teen Volunteer and Youth Worker
what_you_do: You can volunteer at a Berkeley library. Use the Teen Volunteer Application. Or work as a paid Youth Worker, up to 15 hours a week. Berkeley YouthWorks hires Youth Workers.
who_can_apply: Teen volunteer: fill out the application. No age is stated. Youth Worker: ages 14 to 25. No experience is needed. A work permit is required if under 18.
pay_detail: Volunteering is unpaid. Youth Worker jobs are paid (rate not posted; no benefits).
duration: Youth Worker up to 15 hours a week
deadline_text: Library page says YouthWorks accepts applications in March and October only. YouthWorks lists a Winter 2027 interest form due Oct 30, 2026.
how_to_apply: Volunteers: complete the Teen Volunteer Application form. Paid work: go through Berkeley YouthWorks (2180 Milvia St, 510-981-4970); see the YouthWorks page for the current interest form.
notes: The library page also lists other groups that take teen volunteers. Berkeley YouthWorks may require Berkeley residency.
